name: comptime-items
description: The comptime trace breakdown comptime-items.mjs and its Jet twin comptime-items/run.jet, #5072 c7: per span kind, per source file and per item tables and the --json summary of a streamed (unterminated) trace with every comptime step, batch builds split evenly among their items, spans matched per thread (1 and "1" are different threads), inner spans dropped by an outer close, items without a file, kinds named by `name` and stable ties; --top (a count, 0 and the "... N more" line); and the refusals: no trace, --help, a negative, fractional or missing --top and a second trace (exit 2), and an absent, malformed or empty trace, a null event and a span without a kind (exit 1, nothing printed). The JavaScript-coercion trace (string, array and object cpu_ns and file values, string timestamps, 1e400) and the hex --top count are gone: the compiler's trace writer (Compiler/JetCli/Source/Cli/Request.jet jet_cli_trace_head, begin_item and jet_cli_trace_close_line) writes only integer ts, tid and cpu_ns and string file and item, so they tested artifacts of the original rather than the job, and the twin refuses them (its #Test blocks).
